description: This file contains step definitions for Cucumber tests related to loan chargeback operations in the Fineract project. It defines test steps for executing chargeback transactions, retrieving transaction data, and verifying event emissions within the testing framework.

classes.name: LoanChargeBackStepDef
classes.description: A class defining Cucumber test steps for handling loan chargeback operations, including initiating chargebacks and verifying related events.

methods.name: makeLoanChargeback
methods.description: Initiates a chargeback of a specified repayment type and amount for a loan.

methods.name: makeLoanChargebackForPayment
methods.description: Performs a chargeback for a specific payment number for a loan.

methods.name: makeLoanChargebackForDownpaymentayment
methods.description: Performs a chargeback for a down payment number on a loan.

methods.name: makeLoanChargebackForMIR
methods.description: Performs a chargeback for a merchant-issued refund (MIR) number on a loan.

methods.name: makeChargebackCall
methods.description: Executes the API call to perform a chargeback and verifies success.

methods.name: checkEvents
methods.description: Checks that appropriate events are emitted after a chargeback.

methods.name: checkLoanChargebackTransactionEvent
methods.description: Verifies that a chargeback transaction event with expected data was emitted.
